text:
ana: Quick pulse check — I'm ramping rdw-2.1-int4x as a 5% canary behind rdw-2.1. Need to confirm our gating rules and automatic fallback thresholds before we let it run for longer. target: keep user-visible quality within -0.5% and p95 latency within +20%.

devin: @ana aware. Ran a quick 15k-sample A/B in staging (split 50/50 vs baseline sim traffic). TL;DR: cost/token down ~15%, quality_score delta -0.004 (baseline 0.873 -> canary 0.869), hallucination_rate up +0.015 (0.031 -> 0.046) which is unfortunate. p95 latency 110ms -> 132ms (+20%).

liam: thanks. that hallucination jump is > our informal 0.01 soft cap. I think auto-fallback should trigger on hallucination_delta > 0.01 OR quality_delta < -0.005 OR p95_increase_pct >= 20. borderline on latency here.

sophie: +1 to liam. Also add smoothing: require 3 consecutive 10-min eval windows failing before auto-fallback to avoid noisy flips. And enforce a min-sample threshold (>=2k samples) per window.

liam: provisional gating config (for ops):
```json
{
  "canary_rollout_pct": 5,
  "evaluation_window": "10m",
  "min_samples_per_window": 2000,
  "consecutive_windows_to_fail": 3,
  "metrics": {
    "quality_delta_threshold": -0.005,
    "hallucination_delta_threshold": 0.01,
    "p95_latency_increase_pct_threshold": 20
  },
  "auto_fallback": true,
  "fallback_route": "rdw-2.1",
  "post_fallback_action": "snapshot-eval-and-block-promote"
}
```

ana: @liam small nit: use relative thresholds for hallucination when baseline is very low (e.g., /absolute vs /relative). but config looks good.

devin: i ran a quick slice analysis — hallucination spike concentrated on long-context instruction-following prompts (>=1024 tokens) and some multi-step QA. short form generation looks fine. suggests we can keep canary but pin long-context routing to baseline until we fix attention quant edge cases.

sophie: routing tweak idea: route requests with estimated length>800 to baseline during canary. simple prefix check in router. Also add a diagnostic flag that returns a small eval trace to help triage.

liam: agreed. i'll update config to add route overrides and a diagnostic toggle. will also add an alert to ops when auto-fallback fires.

deploy-bot: ALERT: 3123456920 — canary rdw-2.1-int4x observed hallucination_delta 0.016 > configured threshold 0.01. Auto-fallback executed: routing 5% -> rdw-2.1. Logs: /var/logs/canaries/3123456789/fallback-3123456920.log.

ana: thanks bot. next steps: 1) block promote until we fix attention quantization for long-context; 2) keep a 1% low-rate background shadow to collect long-context examples; 3) schedule triage with research this afternoon.

devin: I'll prepare the eval slices and the small reproducible case set. putting a tiny report in the canary runbook. :thumbsup:

sophie: moving to action items in the runbook. adding the 3-window gating + route override. :seedling:

liam: I'll push the config change and add the diagnostic flag. will post updated canary metrics in #eng-ml after the next evaluation window.

ana: perfect. keeping this thread as the canonical pulse. thanks all. :rocket:
